blurb: For over two decades, Dog & Horse Fine Art has been providing clients with quality fine art and cherished commissioned portraits of pets. Since its debut in 2001, it has been the only art gallery in America that specializes in artwork with this subject matter by living artists exclusively. The artists work in a wide array of styles ranging from hyper realism to abstract and minimalist.
